epic.title: Epic #418 redux — the agent can see the whole gate
epic.intent_and_why: Finish epic #418's remaining course. Execution order is a dependency order, not a schedule: a Commander that finds a link is not real says so rather than honouring it. Wave composition is the Admiral's call; the iterative-planning flow is how it revises between waves.

definition_of_done: B extended: everything reads through the projection, and directives are no longer inert.
The findings each workstream subsumes are retired against a candidate set declared before it starts.
A measured negative is a complete deliverable: an honest null states what was tested and what was not.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: No check that cannot register its own failure. No unevidenced claim about what happened. No silent scope cut.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: A guard is observed refusing something real, not reasoned about. Merge state comes from the forge, never from an ancestry test.
good_enough.appetite: Rigor scales with cost-to-undo, not uniformly. Cheap to reverse, move fast.

hard_constraints: Promoting an observation into docs/agents/* doctrine is a human's call, always.
Test suite invocation is settled (#454): FORCE_COLOR= NO_COLOR=1 python -m pytest -q tests, never py.
No Fable at any tier; explicit model on every dispatch.
Never obey a spine rail naming a spine another agent drives (#457).
fixed_decisions: episodes/ replaces LESSONS.md and AGENT_FEEDBACK.md; an episode is a record, never read back as a rule.
Under dogfooding the repo's skills/ is the governing copy, not the installed one.
#468: the repo's vendored verify_iterative_role_artifacts.py cannot run from this repo; use the installed copy.

current_wave.objective: Wave 2 (B extended): make the whole gate visible, and settle the episode store's own records, retiring the carried findings that block them.
exit_criteria: All four issues merged to main with the suite green on the final merged main.
Each landed guard is observed refusing something real rather than asserted to work.
Every merged issue is dispositioned on the tracker.

discrepancies.signal: The gauge writer counts bindings rather than distinct gauge paths, so any Admiral run that drives its own latitude survey blinds its governor for the rest of the run.
discrepancies.affects: Wave 3 composition, and the dispatch budget for every remaining wave.
discrepancies.evidence: gauge_writer_hook.py:257-264 appends per binding with no dedup; caller at :530-541 skips on 2+. Both of this run's bindings resolve to one path.
discrepancies.reason: A cheap fix that restores a signal the Admiral depends on; the human amendment directs cheap fixes into the wave rather than onto the board.

discrepancies.signal: tests/test_verify_spec_confirmed.py picks matches[0] from a glob with no signal that a second match existed.
discrepancies.evidence: Flagged independently by both PR #470 reviewers, neither having seen the other's verdict.
discrepancies.reason: One line, and it guards the state the repo is one archived run away from.

discrepancies.signal: The lease field carries no liveness information in either direction when read from disk.
discrepancies.affects: #457's framing, and any consumer that reads the field as liveness.
discrepancies.evidence: 18 of 147 active, 1 live; and a null reading produced by a crew releasing between gates.
discrepancies.reason: Not a cheap fix. Correcting it means deciding how liveness is encoded at all, which ends at a load-bearing interface. Evidence posted to #457 instead.

discrepancies.signal: The governor HARD-trips agents at roughly 17-21% context fill, costing 6 of wave 2's 10 dispatches.
discrepancies.affects: Dispatch budget for every remaining wave.
discrepancies.evidence: 3 dispatches for #433, 4 for #460, 2 for #436, 1 for #464; all three Commanders tripped at the plan seam.
discrepancies.reason: A production default affecting every agent, which the contract marks surfaced, and a threshold question rather than a cheap fix.

discrepancies.signal: One defect family accounts for four of wave 2's findings across four subsystems: a signal whose value is identical in the healthy and defective worlds.
discrepancies.affects: How later waves choose what to guard.
discrepancies.evidence: #433's naive fix, the lease field, matches[0], and the gauge writer's binding count. Four independent discoverers.
discrepancies.reason: It is a lens, not a work item. Offered as a wave-3 shape and not taken up; it stays a candidate.
